role: T23A audits the T19/T20 low-level node surface in crates/mad-dom-bun/src/handle.rs and freezes it here; it adds no new native export, so no symbol is duplicated (per the T20A seam rule)

createElement.behavior: mints a detached Element; an invalid name throws ERR_MAD_DOM_INVALID_CHARACTER

createText.behavior: mints a detached Text node; frozen native implementation of the WHATWG document.createTextNode (the facade adapts the name; no native createTextNode symbol exists)

nodeType.behavior: WHATWG Node.nodeType (1 Element, 3 Text, 8 Comment, 9 Document, 11 DocumentFragment)

parentNode.behavior: null when the node is detached

firstChild.behavior: null when the node has no children

lastChild.behavior: null when the node has no children

previousSibling.behavior: null at the head of the sibling chain

nextSibling.behavior: null at the tail of the sibling chain

childNodes.behavior: ordered children; an empty array for a leaf node (the live childNodes facade is T25D's)

epochView.behavior: JS-owned 4-byte structural generation view; -2147483648 means destroyed; -1 permanently disables equality-based caching before ABA; transfer detaches this subscription and yields a stale non-shared copy
epochView.fallback: the facade disables navigation memoization when absent

attributeEpochView.behavior: JS-owned 4-byte attribute generation view with the same destroy/cache-disabled sentinels and detach/transfer contract
attributeEpochView.fallback: the facade disables reflected-attribute caching when absent

facadeEpochView.behavior: facade-local structural view published by token hot-write return values

facadeAttributeEpochView.behavior: facade-local attribute view published by token hot-write return values

createElementToken.behavior: creates the same detached Core element as createElement without eagerly minting a NodeHandle

createElementTokenBatch.behavior: creates 1..4096 independent detached Core elements after one name validation

createElementTokenRange.behavior: creates 1..4096 independent detached Core elements and returns the first token of their contiguous registered range

createTextToken.behavior: creates the same detached Core text node as createText without eagerly minting a NodeHandle

materializeNodeToken.behavior: resolves a document-scoped token through the canonical weak wrapper cache

nodeToken.behavior: registers an already-materialized same-document node for raw-to-facade identity convergence

setAttributeToken.behavior: delegates an attribute write for a document-scoped token to Core

setAttributeTokenLocal.behavior: same Core write while returning the canonical attribute epoch for facade-local publication

appendChildToken.behavior: delegates an append of two document-scoped tokens to Core

appendChildTokenLocal.behavior: same Core append while returning the canonical structural epoch for facade-local publication

preorderTokenSnapshot.behavior: up to 65,535 preorder token/classification/depth pairs prefixed by a continuation-depth header (zero when complete)

idAttribute.behavior: fixed-name id attribute read; null when absent
idAttribute.fallback: the facade uses getAttribute with older native packages

classAttribute.behavior: fixed-name class attribute read; null when absent
classAttribute.fallback: the facade uses getAttribute with older native packages

idClassAttributes.behavior: coherent fixed-name id and class attribute reads in one document access
idClassAttributes.fallback: the facade uses the separate fixed-name readers, then getAttribute with older native packages

firstChildPair.behavior: returns at most the first two children; a trailing null proves the child axis ended, while no null means more children follow
firstChildPair.fallback: the facade feature-detects this method and uses firstChild when paired with an older native package

nextSiblingChunk.behavior: returns at most 32 following siblings; a trailing null proves the chain ended, while no null means another bounded chunk may follow
nextSiblingChunk.fallback: the facade feature-detects this method and uses nextSibling when paired with an older native package

identity.rule: every wrapper-producing path funnels through crate::handle::SharedDocument::wrap_node (the per-document weak wrapper cache, T20): while a node wrapper is alive, repeated reads of the same node hand back one and the same JS object (strict equality)
identity.distinct: each createElement / createText call mints a fresh, distinct node

delegation.rule: extensions delegate every tree read to Core through crate::handle::with_document; no second DOM state; a Core NodeId is never fabricated and never crosses the boundary as a primitive
